enunciado: Show all prime numbers between 2 and 50 on one line, and how many there are. Only test divisors up to the square root (d * d <= n).
objetivos: Combine a loop with a boolean flag
Reduce work by stopping the search at the square root
pistas: A prime is only divisible by 1 and itself.
Use a bool variable isPrime that starts as true.
If n has a divisor larger than its root, it also has a smaller one.
